name: Papscanee Island
title: Hudson River Paddling Conditions Near Papscanee Island, NY
blurb: A nature preserve on an island that has not been an island since the channel was filled. Quiet water below Albany.

tide.label: NOAA 8518989 Castleton
tide.note: Tide from NOAA station 8518989 at Castleton, about three and a half miles downriver.
tide.cardNote: Unless you plan on landing on a beach or poking into a shallow creek, tide is likely not very important to you.

current.note: Current from NOAA station HUR0618_8. Flood and ebb headings are the river’s own axis here.
